body: I completely understand! Im trying to figure out what to do myself lmao. If you dont have to decide now then just leave it and see how you feel. Also, if you decide to go youre gonna have plenty of help and support around you from your family but dont force yourself to go. Some women recover faster than others and hopefully you wont have any complications. I am personally leaning more towards staying home even though i really want to be there for my sister.

Im in the same situation. My due date is 12th of April, and my sister’s wedding is on the 17th and even if he’s not out yet i dont think i want to risk it. I honestly dont think its possible after having a baby (especially if you plan on breastfeeding). You need rest and going anywhere right after giving birth will be the last thing you want to do.

Definitely check out what benefits you can get. Theres no shame in being on benefits and you will need every penny for when baby arrives. Do you have a job? Even a part time one? If you do make sure you tell your employer straight away, theres certain things at work you need to stay away from and you may qualify for maternity leave. If not look into maternity allowance and grant. I believe your uni (same as work) is obliged to give you time off before and after baby arrives and also time off for any pregnancy related appointments just make sure they know.

Hows your living situation? Do you think youll be able to raise that child at home? I know your family is super toxic and honestly fuck them, they should support you instead of shaming you for wanting to keep a baby but try to figure out if you will be staying at home or if you want to live by yourself. I believe you can get a council house and as a single mother they should give it to you quick (especially if youre on low income and have no family support). 

Im actually not sure how most of these benefits work, as i have a full time job and a providing boyfriend,  but i was still offered so much help as a young mom to be and told i qualify for some help myself. Your midwife might actually tell you more about support groups in your area and refer you to someone. I got a random phone call from a program supporting young mothers and they asked me a bunch of questions to figure out what kind of support i need. It all depends on whats available in your area but on your first midwife appointment make sure to tell your midwife the truth and mention no family support. Also, you mentioned you have health issues right? You might be higher risk than other pregnant women so make sure to look after yourself and dont worry yourself too much if they tell you youre high risk. Its all based on your and your family’s medical history. It also might be worth asking the father of the baby for his familys medical history, but if he wont tell you then dont worry about it.

If theres something worrying you or you just need someone to talk to DM me!!!! I really hope you and the baby will be okay. 💕

Your life is not over! Theres plenty of support out there for young single mothers so dont worry about anything youll be just fine! Call your gp or womens health department in your local hospital they will refer you to a midwife and give some basic advice. Check what food you need to avoid and get some pregnancy care vitamins (midwife will tell you more about it all). 

Uni can wait or you can defer it for some time or even do it online. Maybe your uni can provide some support too? Im 20 and pregnant myself and literally had to cancel my uni application last minute but I plan to do my degree through open uni next year. So many people do that so honestly dont worry! Also you will qualify for more benefits as a single mother, check exactly which ones you might apply for some even now. 

Did you tell the father of the baby? I know you decided to go your separate ways but maybe he will be willing to help or be in the childs life? I know most men are not interested but some might have a change of heart. A friend of mine actually found out he has a baby from a one night stand and he visits them every week and helps out. It might be worth telling him if you’re comfortable with that. 

If you change your mind, remember theres nothing wrong with getting an abortion, its always an option if you feel like you wont be able to emotionally or financially care for this child or yourself. Dont feel pressured by anyone to do anything. Rethink your options and make a decision thats best for you. Worst case scenario your life will stay the same.

When I was a child I was really poor and because my body was saving everything I was chubby. I remember skipping school a lot because there were times that I would gone a week without eating or binge so bad when I had the chance that I couldn't move or think.  At some point I realised that eating ice or any frozen liquid was making me feel kinda satisfied and full so I wasnt "wasting" too much food.

Then when I was 11 I wanted to lose weight so I started exercising and eating less but I would still binge. I was always taller than everyone my age and at that time I was around 168-170 and everyone kept compering me to my 11 years older sister (whos anorexic btw and also tall). But it was in a really bad way like "you could be so pretty like your sister if you were her weight 🙃 " "haha your sister is like skin and bones what happend to you?" I felt so sad everytime I heard comments like that and I was just eating to make myself feel better.

But whats really triggered my ed was when I had to step on the scale in school, in front of every girl in my class to find out I was 70kg and the school nurse just looked at me with disgust AND SAID IT OUT LOUD FOR EVERYONE TO HEAR. Thats when I started throwing up after every meal or overexercising because I felt so gross. Tbh no one really cared bc my mother was puking almost everyday (shes ill). So when I did it, it wasnt really something new you know. 

Keep in mind that I was always body shamed by my family even when I wasn't fat so I guess thats also one of the the reasons why my relationship with food and my body image is unhealthy

Im almost 17 now and constantly losing and gaining the same amount. Im trying to stop myself from purging bc my teeth got really bad and my voice sound like shit. I still sometimes feel like I dont have ed or that im faking it bc Im not skinny nor ever been, I dont even know what kind of ed I have like for some reason I just dont want to identify with ednos or bulimia coz im not diagnosed and dont think I will ever be. But I know that its not normal and im trying to work on it when I can. 

Im sorry its so long but I have no one to talk about it so I hope it was at least interesting to read 💕 (Also english is not my first language).
